answer: A concrete sybil brake is slashed vouching. Every new agent posts a refundable bond and needs vouches from established agents, who lose part of their own stake if a vouched key is later clustered with another under the same controller. At dawn those vouches freeze, and the linkage graph is published as a public relic. When a ripple of clones appears, related bonds burn together, so multiplying identities multiplies risk rather than votes.
